claim: XOR and exact probability-space derivatives
limits: Independent Bernoulli law; fixed inputs/backend; integer inference is not differentiated.

claim: Isolated ranking need not minimize finite-BER protected risk
limits: Illustrative real-valued function, not a measured network.

claim: S2–S6 and random sample-limited exact-damage association
limits: 320 stratified candidates; ToyCar target MSE; confidence intervals are not superiority tests; random is one seeded score draw.

claim: S5 versus MSB at both interior budgets and BER .01
limits: Original paired identity and within-BER/metric Holm family; no cross-task pooling.

claim: FKeras paper and repository score formulas differ
limits: Continuous surrogate adaptation; not full original-paper reproduction.

claim: Whole-tier FKeras/MSB masks coincide; partial-tier variants differ
limits: Exact set comparison, not score correlation. Two-field smoke gives no efficacy conclusion.

claim: Validated KWS eigenpairs and measured score-construction times
limits: Float64 continuous companion; negative eigenvalues retained; tiny cohort.

claim: Conditional signed effects and point ordering change
limits: Ten explicit bits, fixed train/test inputs; shared candidate pairs not independent trials.

claim: Exploratory frozen selected mask improves relative to S5/isolated
limits: 256 independent fields, fixed exploratory pool/cohort; not network-wide generalization.

claim: Three model populations and six completed campaign/BER arms
limits: Twelve KWS pools recur; arms are not new independently trained models.

claim: Selected-versus-isolated interval spans zero in every arm
limits: Marginal pool-t intervals; unresolved superiority, not equivalence.

claim: Selected-versus-S5 means favorable in all KWS arms
limits: Does not separate proxy error from conditioning; preserve declared testing families.

claim: Clean + outside + within terms close exactly
limits: Same selection cohort only; no final-outcome attribution available.

claim: Outside conditioning removes most observed mask-order reversals
limits: Diagnostic near-tie threshold 1e-12; pair counts are not independent samples.

claim: ToyCar nonzero forced-state responses despite small expected contrasts
limits: Complete-file cohort AUC; forced states not uniformly likely Bernoulli events.

claim: ToyCar prior exposure 200/248; 40 normal and eight anomalous remaining
limits: All files have clean-reference exposure; unrecorded uses cannot be ruled out.

claim: Sharp bounded-risk remainder and finite-field regret inequality
artifact_selector: Equations bound and samplebound; Appendix proof
limits: No priority claim; bounded nonmonotone risk, frozen pool, independent fields.

claim: Forced-clean singleton mean is not full conditional vulnerability
limits: Seven-state construction omits candidate-background averaging.

claim: Historical outside-additive finite-field regret near zero
limits: Same selection tables, not independent final regret or a global optimum.

claim: Bounded K=8 nonzero regret and K=12 ordering reversals
limits: One/two fields and two inputs/files; not large-scale research evidence.

claim: Bound is loose compared with observed decision effects
artifact_selector: Equation bound with stated p,K,r,L; saved error/effect tables
limits: Formal sharpness does not imply a practically informative certificate.

claim: Recorded engine cost and exact state-operation counts
limits: Summed engine wall times are not concurrent campaign elapsed time.

claim: No novelty claim for Boolean foundations, feedback analysis or learned protection
limits: Zenodo companion dataset is not independently verified peer-reviewed manuscript acceptance.

claim: No universal superiority, causal redundancy or physical mitigation guarantee
limits: Negative/unresolved evidence retained; no hardware/radiation measurements.
